purpose: Improve industrial floor depth and overdrive HUD readability while reducing Canvas command cost and preserving responsive interaction contracts.
background: procedural opaque industrial floor plus opaque HUD card fields
camera: fixed 45-degree actor presentation over a world-space 2D floor
generation_model: deterministic Godot draw primitives and Control theme overrides; no generative model or third-party source
negative_constraints: no animated background noise, per-tile node creation, unbounded draw list, actor-obscuring floor contrast, or modal HUD behavior
no health, shield, progression, wave, pause, audio, overdrive duration, charge, input, focus, or gameplay contract drift
